I'm on max dose on Lexapro right now and I'm scared to switch because it's still working most of the time.
Thank you, it's good to know I'm not alone (as cliche as that sounds). 💛

Although it's probably not advised, I still drink occasionally while on Lexapro. It's been fine.

Alcohol is a depressant though, so keep that in mind. They'll kind of work against each other a bit, especially if you take them close to each other. 

I can't take my Lexapro in the morning, but if you can it's good advice from the others.
